data.body:
[P2] Approach: substantiate the blanket retry assumption under rule 6

The PR assumes every non-`AwsServiceException` means the service sent no response, which justifies retrying every `RuntimeException` here. Its Assumptions section repeats that claim as evidence but cites no document, real-client test, or observed run, and does not mark it `unverified`. The added tests inject exceptions into fake clients and therefore cannot establish this boundary. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and provide the required evidence or explicitly mark the assumption unverified so its validation can be agreed.
